name: 2-10x Tech Cost
description: Every technology level on the Tech screen costs 2 to 10 times its normal price in tech points: you choose the multiplier with the 2-10x Tech Cost slider in the patcher window (a whole number, 3 unless you move it). The normal prices are: Science level 2 8,000, level 3 70,000; Medicine level 2 5,000, level 3 50,000; Learning level 2 4,000, level 3 35,000; Construction level 2 5,000, level 3 65,000; Food Mastery level 2 3,000, level 3 40,000; Spirituality level 2 8,000, level 3 80,000. At x 3, for example, a 5,000-point level costs 15,000. The Tech screen shows the multiplied price, a purchase is refused (and nothing is spent) with fewer tech points than that, and buying takes exactly that many. Research, tech points from anywhere else, every other tech-point cost (such as clothes) and the patcher's own upgrades are unchanged. The higher you set it, the harder the game. **Needs no other patch.**
behavior_changes: Every non-zero entry of the technology price table 0x4CA3B4, x N (the slider, 2 to 10; 3 by default). Its only reader is the getter 0x4236D0, called by the Tech screen's hover label, information box and purchase (0x440DCA, 0x4412A0, 0x441676): the shown price, the purchase's refusal threshold and the amount it takes are the same multiplied number.
explicit_non_changes: Each price is changed in place, same length; no code is added and no executable space is claimed.

Research, tech points from island events and duplicate collectibles, every other tech-point cost (such as 5,000 for clothes) and the patcher's Origins and Story / Cheat upgrades keep their stock numbers.
